The guided plan step

Phase 3 · step 3.8  2026-10-20  ·  branch feat/phase-3-coach-plans  ·  scope ui

What this commit does
  • /workout shows PlanSession when the active session has plan_ids. A free session still shows the Phase 2 LiveSession, unchanged.
  • New components in components/plans/: PlanStepHeader (back or leave, title, Step N of M · Group, elapsed time), StepProgress (1 bar per step), StepFrame (Start, End, Play, Muscles), PlanSetRows (logged and draft rows), StepFooter (Skip and Next, Finish session on the last step).
  • AppShell gains mode="focus" through components/ui/FocusMode.tsx: no bottom bar under 1024 px, the sidebar stays.
  • Next, Back and Skip write the cursor through setPlanCursor before the screen moves. Skip writes the step slug, which closes the 3.5 open item.
  • The rows fill from lastSetFor. lastSetsFor now counts finished, live sessions only, the same rule, through one helper finishedSetsOf. The picker's Recent list leaves out the live session.
  • The plan step gains bodyweight, set by scripts/coach-data.mjs from equipment === 'body only'. Only bench-dips. A body-weight step shows a fixed Body cell and saves a null load, also on the 3.7 preview.
  • Skip is hidden on the last step.
  • tests/e2e/plans.spec.ts is new. responsive.spec.ts adds the plan-mode block with the 2 exceptions the step file names: focus mode, and the 4 view buttons at 40 px.
  • PROGRESS.md and the step index mark 3.8 done, add step 3.8b for the owner's device feedback, and move Checkpoint B to after 3.8b.
Improvements
  • A plan runs one step at a time, with the image, the muscles, the target and the last weight on one screen.
  • A reload resumes at the same step, because the cursor is written first.
  • The picker and the guided step now agree on the last set.
  • The new unit tests run with reduced motion, so jsdom no longer runs the endless bar animation and the Play timer.
Fallbacks
  • The plan summary, the laptop layout and the header End session wait for 3.9. Finish shows the Phase 2 SessionSummary.
  • A body-weight step takes no added load.
  • The style guide entries and the axe run on plan mode wait for 3.10.
  • On a first time, logging set 1 does not copy its weight into the rows below.
Things to consider
  • The owner's device test raised 8 changes: any order through a step list sheet, Finish at any time, a weight dropdown per equipment, 2 view buttons How to and Muscles, the target as plain text, ▶ Tutorial on YouTube, and a compact card. They are in docs/plan/phase-3/S3.8b-guided-step-feedback.md. Part 1 changes the prototype only, and the owner sees a demo first.
  • + Add set is 54 px and 15 px text; the plate shows 44 px and 14 px.
  • Plate 18 shows a fixed Start → End caption. The code follows the step file.
  • The Muscles key shows "helper" in faint accent, while the map draws helpers faint in their group colour.
  • offline.spec.ts:65 on WebKit failed once in the full run, a known flake. It passed 3 of 3 alone.
  • A next dev run in the worktree overwrote the production .next during the device test. The build was redone.
